canonical_source.checkpoint_commit_policy: This record follows the artifact commit. Read its own commit from Git history; it does not contain a circular self-reference.

plugin.readback_scope: Manifest, release record, component pins, save poller, canonical session and two compatibility entry points. Not a full plugin archive or binary comparison.

site.blocker: Native Sites source/export/build/save/publish tools were not available. GitHub contains bundled presentation source, not the full Site persistence routes, authentication, lockfiles or build configuration.

shared_source.historical_qa: Original component versions and bytes retained; no new device or listening evidence inferred.

source_pin_negative_checks.meaning: Modified runtime and inherited QA bytes rejected; exact baseline bytes restored.

improvements: Scene-bound audio retries cannot substitute campfire preview narration; exact voice keys and first-cue plans are validated.
Required narration and optional cue failures are distinct; finished cues and unused buses are not missing assets.
Introduction/campfire pause watchers and stale callbacks are safe; the 60-second deadline begins before the earliest preview voice.
Site source no longer auto-restarts on playback status alone; generic gesture recovery does not undo Pause or Stop.
Read-only refresh avoids overlapping polls, stops hidden scheduling, backs off on errors and exposes a stale-save warning.
Five compatibility entry points use canonical lib modules; component hashes detect drift without relabeling old QA as new evidence.

iteration_accounting.score: No rescore. The PDF 4.5/10 remains a dated baseline, not a current verified rating.

rollback.procedure: Review current heads; restore affected code through a new non-destructive commit and a guarded plugin release. Restore only intended presentation files. No database migration occurred; never reset the real save. Native Site was not changed by this session.

synchronization.workflow: Inspect both current artifacts; review deltas; update explicit component pins only for reviewed changes; run npm run verify; compare the Git tree to tested bytes; push with expected head; overlay changed plugin files with expected release; read back; then save a separate checkpoint.
synchronization.native_site_gate: Export the existing Site, reconcile rather than overwrite, verify its identity/authentication and persistence contracts, test isolated fixtures, then build/save/publish the matching existing Site and verify read-only live behavior.
synchronization.automation: GitHub CI detects tracked-source drift. No continuous Site/plugin auto-sync or automatic save bridge is claimed.

next_step: Obtain the existing native Site source/export and publication capability; inspect campaign ownership and transaction routes, then implement WP02-WP04 before claiming a coordinated playable release.
